## Review status

## Privacy and sanitization

- [ ] No raw ticket export or copied internal ticket thread is included.
- [ ] Real names, contact information, ticket identifiers, and unrelated personal information were removed.
- [ ] Screenshots were cropped, permanently redacted, and reviewed at full size.
- [ ] Internal IP addresses, URLs, hostnames, domains, server paths, credentials, and reset values were removed.
- [ ] Asset tags, serial numbers, keys, certificates, tokens, environment files, and secret files were removed.
- [ ] Instructor-only deployment/reset methods and internal remote-support implementation details are excluded.
- [ ] No real production customer or confidential organization information is present.

## Validation

- [ ] `python3 tools/validate_portfolio.py` (or the platform-equivalent Python command) passes locally.
- [ ] I reviewed `git diff` and every added evidence file.
- [ ] All relative links work from GitHub.
